'''Andrew Liu Andy's Mains & Toys Deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Andrew Liu]]
* '''Published:''' November 1998 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Dagobah: Yoda's Hut]]
* '''Strategy:''' Andy's Mains & Toys Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PSE Andy's Mains & Toys Deck Liu LS 1998.txt |Download]]
